package.name: PartDesignUpgrade
package.description: Extends the PartDesign workbench with helpers: create or subtract parametric pipes along sketch paths, create a sketchless stiffening rib between two selected faces (angled corner or plane + cylinder), cut multiple bodies with a single sketch, mirror the body automatically around planes or axes (floating on/off panel: every change to the body is mirrored), and compute body weight/volume with a material density selector, plus an assembly collision detector that makes every body transparent and highlights the interpenetrating parts.
package.author: Cipa
